info.name: ElektraWeb Booking API For Hotels
info.description:
Welecome to ElektraWeb's Booking API documentation.

in order to implement our REST API's in your project successfully please follow the following tips:

  • All the requests require JWT_CODE or Google ReCaptcha's Token decide which one are you planning to use before starting, keep in mind for some cases there will be extra headers required in order to have a working requests.
  • /Login request will only be used if you're planning to use JWT_CODE
  • For Google ReCaptcha you should send it as a header with 'x-captcha' as header name and token as value, you should get the site key from us in order to have a token.

request.description:
Ways to Login:

  • Hotel User:

    • fill body with : ( "hotel-id", "usercode", "password" )

  • ApiKey:

    • fill header with { "AUTHORIZATION": "Bearer APIKEY_TOKEN" }

  • LoginToken:

    • fill body with { "login-token": "Login_Token" }

Request Body:

property type description
hotel-id number
rate-type-id number from the selected price object
board-type-id number from the selected price object
rate-code-id number from the selected price object
room-type-id number from the selected price object
room-id number? assign reservation to a exact room-id
currency-code string from the selected price object
total-price number from the selected price object
price-agency-id number from the selected price object
adult-count number
nationality string guest's nationality ISO CODE2 Country Code ex. TR
check-in number date in this format 'yyyy-MM-dd'
check-out number date in this format 'yyyy-MM-dd'
market-id number? Hotel's default final price with discount
elder-child-count number?
younger-child-count number?
baby-count number?
guest-list Guest-List Object? as described below
res-notes string? reservation's note
room-count number?
contact-first-name string? contact guest name
contact-last-name string? contact guest last name
contact-email string? contact guest email
contact-phone string? contact guest phone
seller-commission number? percent of discount to be given
voucher-no string? reservation's voucher number ( like PNR )
payment-type number? reservation's payment type (2 as NOT PAID, 3 as PAID)
tax-company string?
tax-no string?
tax-place string?
tax-address string?
tax-type number? Type (personal: 2 / company: 1)

Guest-List Object:

property type description
title-id number guest's title ( 0 = MR , 1 = MS , 2 = CHILD , 3 = BABY )
gender number? OPTIONAL
country number? OPTIONAL
name number guest's first name
surname number guest's last name
birthday number? IF title-id is 2 or 3 then it is REQUIRED
guest's birthdate in this format 'YYYY-MM-DD'
nationality-no string? OPTIONAL
passport-no string? OPTIONAL
email string? OPTIONAL
phone string? OPTIONAL
